title: Answering some questions on rural cottage life
en: the smoke has come to my valley as the wildfires take their course it is a reminder of how fragile things can be i must always be grateful for what i have this is crucial in order to live an abundant life despite the bitter smell of soot in the air there is work to be done autumn is fast approaching the trees are whispering to each other time to prepare for the cold and so must i this video is going to be a little different and that is because my options

for filming have been greatly limited due to the smoke and poor air quality instead i decided to simply answer some questions that you have been asking while i do that i thought i'd share some insight in how i make early preparations for fall for example collecting pine cones to later make into fire starters a common question i get is where do you live so i live in the united states more specifically in northern washington state in little valley in the okanogan county within the town limits i believe there are about 500 residents there are no chain restaurants and pretty much all the locals know each other out here you have to come to terms with

untamed nature there are coyotes and cougars the occasional moose and bear many deer and wild rabbits i personally enjoy observing this side of nature but it is definitely not for everyone another question i get is do i live alone also many ask am i lonely i find the latter question to be rather interesting because i get the impression that there are many lonely people all around the world and many live in bustling cities have friends and partners and yet still

feel isolated and alone i do not think loneliness or depression depend on if you live with people or not i view it as an emotion not a location or relationship status let me know what your thoughts are on this and if you agree or not i find it to be very interesting before i moved to the countryside i did feel lonely while i yearned to be nearer to my family i realized more importantly my interior life needed to be enriched and my sense of purpose solidified this sent me on a journey of self-growth that led me here now i spend time with my pets partner in family every day

i'm half puerto rican and a strong sense of hispanic culture in my family has us always spending time together but i will add that my sense of happiness and fullness comes from much more than my relations it is from an inner contentment that is not reliant on external sources it is an inner strength that i'm always working on cultivating and growing i also must add that i'm an introvert and prefer quiet life so socializing and meeting new people isn't a priority for me i realize that that may seem unusual to those who are more social than i but it is my nature many of you also wanted to know how do i afford to live here so i won't go into the details but in

short i diversify my income i work as a teacher at an alternative preschool on weekends i go to farmer's markets and sell my art greeting cards and crafts i recently opened an etsy shop and would like to make at least a small success of that someday as well also my family is very close-knit they're involved in every step of my journey offering needed support wisdom and love some of you also wanted to know how i get wi-fi reception the short answer is i don't the hills around my cottage make it difficult but if i simply walk up a hill a ways or visit my mother's house nearby i can get reception i find ways to cope with this by pre-downloading audiobooks and shows and documentaries i'm

interested in watching also it gives me time free of distractions when i'm working on a new art piece in my case the inconvenience really isn't that troublesome lastly a common question i get is what are my pets names so my rabbit's name is mr darcy i have owned many rabbits in my life and he is by far the grumpiest he does not like waiting for his food or staying indoors when it's cold however he does love head rubs and pets so much that he outright demands them by pulling on your clothes my dog's name is iger and he just turned a year old he is very loyal maybe too loyal he once ran over a mile

after my car when i left for work and hurt his paws in the process he's always happy we'll give you very aggressive licks and is still learning how to be civilized anyway i hope answering these questions was helpful to some of you i will be sharing some new cottage crafts next week in relation to autumn

preparations thank you again for all the kind comments on these videos you may notice that i do my very best to respond to each of you and if i ever miss your comment by mistake do let me know and i'm happy to answer it you
zh: 随着野火的蔓延，烟雾来到了我的山谷，这提醒我，事物是多么脆弱，我必须永远感激我所拥有的，这对于过上丰富的生活至关重要，尽管空气中弥漫着苦涩的烟灰味，还有工作要做。
由于烟雾和空气质量差，拍摄受到很大限制，相反，我决定简单地回答你们一直在问的一些问题，我想我会分享一些关于我如何为秋天做好早期准备的见解，例如收集松果以供稍后制作点火器。几乎所有当地人都在这里互相认识，你必须接受
未经驯服的大自然，有郊狼和美洲狮，偶尔有驼鹿，还有许多鹿和野兔，我个人喜欢观察大自然的这一面，但这绝对不适合所有人。
感到孤立和孤独 我不认为孤独或抑郁取决于你是否与人一起生活 我认为它是一种情感而不是一个位置或关系状态 让我知道你对此有何想法 如果你同意或不同意 我觉得这很有趣 在我搬到农村之前 我确实感到孤独 当我渴望离我的家人更近时 我意识到更重要的是我的内心生活需要丰富，我的目标感得到巩固，这让我踏上了自我成长的旅程，现在我花时间与家人在一起我的宠物每天都是家庭伙伴
我有一半波多黎各血统，家庭中强烈的西班牙文化意识使我们总是花时间在一起，但我要补充一点，我的幸福感和充实感不仅仅来自于我的关系，而是来自于一种不依赖于外部来源的内心满足感，这是我一直在努力培养和成长的内在力量。对于那些比我更社交的人来说，这似乎很不寻常，但这是我的本性，你们中的许多人也想知道我如何负担得起住在这里，所以我不会详细介绍，但在

简而言之，我的收入多样化，我周末在一所另类幼儿园当老师，我去农贸市场，卖我的艺术贺卡和工艺品，我最近开了一家 etsy 商店，希望有一天能至少取得一点小成功，而且我的家人关系非常密切，他们参与我旅程的每一步，提供所需的支持和智慧，你们中的一些人也想知道我如何获得 wi-fi 信号，简短的回答是，我的小屋周围的山丘并不会让这变得困难，但是如果我只是步行爬上一座山，或者去附近我母亲的房子，我就能得到接待，我会通过预先下载有声读物、节目和纪录片来找到解决这个问题的方法
对观看也很感兴趣，当我在创作一件新的艺术作品时，它给了我不受干扰的时间，就我而言，不便实际上并不是那么麻烦，最后一个常见问题是我的宠物叫什么名字，所以我的兔子的名字是达西先生，我一生中养过很多兔子，他是迄今为止最脾气暴躁的人，他不喜欢等待食物或在寒冷的时候呆在室内，但他非常喜欢头部按摩和宠物，以至于他直接要求它们穿上你的衣服，我的狗叫艾格，他刚满一岁，他非常忠诚，也许太忠诚了，他曾经跑过一英里
当我开车去上班时，在这个过程中弄伤了他的爪子，他总是很高兴我们会给你非常积极的舔，而且仍然在学习如何文明，无论如何我希望回答这些问题对你们中的一些人有帮助我下周将分享一些与秋天有关的新乡村工艺品
准备工作再次感谢您对这些视频的所有善意评论，您可能会注意到我会尽力回复你们每个人，如果我错误地错过了您的评论，请告诉我，我很乐意回答您
